title: Technology Sector Update for 08/20/2018: SEII,BABA,AAPL

Technology stocks slightly firmer in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.2% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index advanced over 0.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
- Sharing Economy International ( SEII ) fell almost 7% on Monday after agreeing to buy 60% of Gagfare, an online platform to search flights, for $3.6 million in stock. Under the terms of the transaction, the company will issue 1.2 million shares of its preferred stock, valuing privately held Gagfare at about $3.061 per preferred share.
In other sector news:
+ Alibaba ( BABA ) climbed as much as 2.5% following reports the Chinese e-commerce platform is talking with India-based Reliance Retail about a potential joint venture, which could also include a $5 billion investment in India's largest retail chain.
- Apple ( AAPL ) shares were less than 1% lower after the tech giant reportedly removed up to 25,000 illegal apps previously sold by its app store in China. The removed apps represent roughly 1.4% of the 1.8 million apps available on the website, with many selling lottery tickets or providing illegal gambling services, according to the Wall Street Journal, citing data from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
